## Axon Enterprise Shares Fall ~10% Following $1 Billion Convertible Note Offering

The ~10% selloff on the convert offering — despite capped calls — suggests the market is assigning meaningful dilution risk or skepticism about capital deployment; for a PM holding AXON, the question is whether the selloff is an entry opportunity on unchanged fundamentals or a signal of overvaluation before the offering.

- Axon Enterprise shares declined approximately 9.8% in the session following its $1 billion convertible note offering.
- Coverage directly links the selloff to the capital structure event, suggesting the market is pricing dilution risk or use-of-proceeds uncertainty.
- The outlet raises the question of what comes next for the stock, implying the fundamental story is not viewed as impaired.
